task: Use the pdf skill to add a cover page to the report.pdf file with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.
utility_reason: task_success: Created report_with_cover.pdf and supporting cover_page.pdf/png via make_cover.py, which adds a cover page titled 'Annual Financial Report' with the current date before report.pdf.

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader
reader = PdfReader('report.pdf')
print(f'Number of pages: {len(reader.pages)}')
print(f'Metadata: {reader.metadata}')
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    text = page.extract_text()
    print(f'--- Page {i+1} ---')
    print(text)
"

date +"%B %d, %Y" && python3 -c "import pypdf; print('pypdf OK')" && python3 -c "import reportlab; print('reportlab OK')" && python3 -c "from datetime import date; print(date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y'))"
pip install reportlab 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 -c "from datetime import date; print('Python date:', date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y'))"
